title: arundo formosana subsp. robusta
intro: Arundo formosana subsp. robusta, commonly known as Taiwan cane, is a type of giant cane that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, Arundo formosana subsp. robusta has been found to possess immunomodulatory and antioxidant activities, making it a valuable resource for further research in the field of phytotherapy.
